description.value: Gallery 1710 is the home of the South Delta Artists Guild in Tsawwassen, showcasing rotating monthly exhibitions of original works by local artists spanning realism to abstract, watercolour to mixed media and 3D art. Located just minutes from the Tsawwassen ferry terminal and close to the Delta dike cycling network, it makes a natural cultural stop for cyclists passing through the area. The guild, incorporated in 1975, also runs workshops and Saturday artist demonstrations open to the public.
